svg.aria-label: An indexing table on a round bed. Three token columns, A, B and C, stand around a turning dial; every token is a call to queue(signal, key) with that column's key. When the press is free, the dial turns to the column the fair queue just granted, a pusher slides that column's bottom token onto the dial, the dial carries it to the press, and a trap under the press drops it through the bed.
svg.title: superlock fair queue
